facts.fact: The World Bank status report says Component 2 of the Sierra Leone Land Administration Project will start new procurements to fast-track digitization of land records and development of a digital land information system, with the system development consultancy to be advertised in April 2024.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Country Planning

note: A boundary harmonisation pilot is stated; no land information system for transactions is named.

facts.fact: Sierra Leone's Chief Minister said in April 2025 that the lands ministry anticipates the launch of a land management information system, under the Sierra Leone Land Administration Project.

systems.owner: Ministry of Lands, Housing and Country Planning

facts.fact: The World Bank's October 2024 status report says procurement is ongoing for a digital land information system for Sierra Leone's Ministry of Lands, with the contract tender still open and no transactions yet registered in it.
